paragraphs: R. Yishmael ben Gamliel, Jerusalem Talmud, HaRo'eh, mishnah 2. Perhaps it is a scribal error and should read R. Shimon. Yet Sefer Sedeh Yehoshua also has this reading and repeatedly cites in R. Yishmael ben Gamliel's name.
